info.title: Gravurtastisch API Documentation
info.description: Official REST API documentation for Gravurtastisch Admin & Seller Panel. Provides comprehensive endpoints for authentication, user management, order review request automation, Amazon SP-API integration, subscription plans, roles & permissions, site configuration, support tickets, and system audit logs.

tags.description: User authentication, OTP verification, password updates, and JWT session tokens.

post.description: Sends a temporary 6-digit one-time password to the specified user email address for passwordless sign-in.

example.message: OTP sent to your email successfully. Please verify to continue.

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code sent to user email and returns JWT access & refresh tokens along with user details.

get.summary: Get Current Enriched User by Bearer Token
get.description: Validates the active session Bearer token and returns the full user document enriched with section-level permissions and active plan details.

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a fresh access token without re-authenticating.
Creates a standard user account with email and password.
Revokes refresh token and clears active session cookies.

get.description: Admin panel: Returns paginated list of all seller accounts with plan details, used requests, and active status.
Admin panel: Returns paginated list of internal admin staff and assigned roles.
Seller panel: Returns team members under current seller organization.

post.description: Adds a new team user under the seller's organization.

put.summary: Update User Status, Role & Custom Plan Limits
put.description: Admin or Seller Manager updates status (0=inactive, 1=active, 2=delete), assigned role, or custom quotas.

post.summary: Manually Assign Subscription Plan to Seller
post.description: Admin panel: Assigns or overrides a subscription plan for a seller without requiring Stripe payment.
Admin panel: Immediately cancels active subscription for seller.

put.description: Updates current logged-in user name, email, and contact phone.

post.description: Uploads an avatar picture file via multipart/form-data with key 'file'.
Removes avatar picture of current logged-in user.

get.summary: Get Orders List with Review Solicitation Status
get.description: Seller Panel: Retrieves paginated Amazon orders synced from SP-API, review request status, and plan usage counters.

put.summary: Schedule Amazon Review Requests for Orders
put.description: Schedules automated Amazon SP-API review solicitation emails for selected order IDs according to seller active marketplaces and plan quotas.

example.message: Review requests scheduled successfully for 2 orders.

example.message: You have no active marketplaces configured. Please configure and activate at least one marketplace first.

403.description: Plan quota exceeded or plan expired

example.message: Your monthly review request quota has been reached. Please upgrade your plan.

get.description: Fetches list of all official Amazon regional marketplaces (DE, FR, IT, ES, UK, US, etc.) with marketplace IDs and region domains.

get.summary: Get Current Seller Amazon SP-API Credentials
get.description: Retrieves active LWA App Client ID, Seller ID, and SP-API tokens for the authenticated seller.

post.summary: Create or Update Amazon SP-API Credentials
post.description: Upserts Amazon LWA application credentials and seller refresh token.

get.description: Fetches automation rules, active marketplaces list, and daily review solicitation execution time.

put.description: Updates seller review scheduling time and active marketplaces (validated against max marketplace allowance in active plan).

400.description: Exceeded plan marketplaces limit or invalid rules

example.message: Your current plan only permits up to 3 active marketplaces. Please upgrade your subscription.

get.description: Fetches public/active subscription plans with pricing, quota limits, and billing intervals.

Initiates a Stripe Hosted Checkout Session for a seller subscribing to a paid plan. Returns session ID and checkout URL.
Processes raw Stripe webhook events (invoice.paid, checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.deleted).
